preconditions.description: The number of users n is between 2 and 250,000.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of integers a_i, b_i in the next n-1 lines represents an edge in T_1
preconditions.description: The edges in T_1 form a tree.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of integers c_i, d_i in the next n-1 lines represents an edge in T_2
preconditions.description: The edges in T_2 form a tree.
There are n-1 edges in T_1 and n-1 edges in T_2.

postconditions.description: The number of edges that can be protected m is between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: Each of the m lines contains four integers a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i
postconditions.description: Each line represents an edge replacement in the format specified.

postconditions.expression: The network remains connected after each replacement
postconditions.description: After replacing an edge in T_1 with an edge in T_2, the network must remain connected.

postconditions.expression: The edges in T_2 can be used at most once
postconditions.description: Each edge in T_2 can be used as a replacement for at most one edge in T_1.

invariants.expression: The trees T_1 and T_2 are connected and acyclic
invariants.description: Both T_1 and T_2 are trees, meaning they are connected and have no cycles.

invariants.expression: The bipartite graph represents valid tree edge replacements
invariants.description: The bipartite graph between E(T_1) and E(T_2) only includes edges where adding f to T_1 makes the graph connected.
